claim_one_line: THE LEE VERIFICATION (R52-3 discharged; the E37 CITED/UNVERIFIED grade B1198 carried is paid -- the paper was OBTAINED AND READ on this bench, not cited from an abstract). THREE QUESTIONS ANSWERED FROM THE SOURCE. (Q1) THE ADMISSIBLE TANGENT-VECTOR SET IS A TORSOR UNDER Z/|a_1|, AND FOR OUR OBJECT THAT GROUP IS TRIVIAL: Lee states the count directly ('in general, there are several (i.e. as many as |a_1|) choices for a tangent vector d/dz giving a_2 in (2pi i)Z'), and his Appendix A computes a_1 = +1,-1,+1,-1 at the four ideal points of 4_1 with all four satisfying Conjecture 7.4.2. NOT TAKEN ON TRUST: a_1 and b_1 are the orders of vanishing of the meridian and longitude, so (a_1,b_1) is a PRIMITIVE EDGE VECTOR of the Newton polygon of the A-polynomial -- main's own B67 -- and computing that polygon here gives the four edges (4,-1),(4,1),(-4,1),(-4,-1), hence (a_1,b_1) = (-1,4),(1,4),(1,-4),(-1,-4), EVERY EDGE WITH |dL| = 1 so |a_1| = 1 AT EVERY IDEAL POINT, with boundary slopes +-4 matching the figure-eight's known values. The structural reason is now ours: the A-polynomial's Newton polygon is THIN IN L. CONSEQUENCE -- THE HOPED-FOR BRIDGE IS CLOSED: the torsor group is trivial, so it is NOT Z/2 and NOT V_4 and there is NO CONTACT between Lee's choice-of-base-point and the programme's orientation bit (B1174/B1182/B1183); the identification 'the outside instance of the missing archimedean marking' FAILS, with a stated mechanism rather than as an absence. This also CONFIRMS B1201 FROM THE SOURCE -- B1198's withdrawn claim was correctly withdrawn, now double-sourced. (Q2) THE 4_1 CONFIRMATION DOES NOT USE THE CS=0 DEGENERACY: Appendix A runs on Hikami's Neumann-Zagier potential on the deformation curve, evaluated by dilogarithm identities, with limits +-4*zeta(2) = +-2pi^2/3 (rational multiples of (2pi i)^2 as the conjecture requires); B1195/GC-21's degeneracy plays no role, so that contact point closes too -- the one genuine adjacency is that Hikami's curve comes from the SADDLE POINT METHOD, the same instrument family. (Q3) THE TRACE FIELD SPECIALIZES EXACTLY AND WITH NO SPECIAL-CASING: Theorem 2 places the motive in Ext^1_{MT(k(M))}(Q(0),Q(2)) over the INVARIANT TRACE FIELD k(M), and for m004 k(M) IS Q(sqrt-3) -- the construction lands over the programme's own field by its general statement. WHAT REMAINS: the positive half STANDS and is the valuable half (an outside published mixed Tate motive over Q(sqrt-3) whose Beilinson regulator is our complex volume, with 4_1 a verified appendix case) while THE W_0 BAR STANDS UNCHANGED -- Lee does not supply the free archimedean marking SEAM-A is missing, because for our manifold there is nothing free there at all. Fences: the answers are quoted from the source and Lee's computations are cited not re-derived, EXCEPT |a_1| = 1 which is independently derived here and therefore does not rest on his appendix; Conjecture 7.4.2 remains a conjecture in general (verified for 4_1 and one ideal point of 5_1). Gate 5 clean.
